## Promotion

Official source: [Florida Residents Can Save Up to 30% on Select Sailings](https://disneycruise.disney.go.com/special-offers/florida-residents-rates/)

Exact source match:

- 5-night Very Merrytime Western Caribbean Cruise
- Disney Fantasy
- 2026-11-20
- Up to 30% off voyage fare for eligible Florida residents

Public-safe qualified claim:

`Eligible Florida residents can save up to 30% on voyage fare on this selected November 20 Disney Fantasy sailing. Limited availability and terms apply.`

Required terms:

- At least one adult in each stateroom must present accepted proof of Florida residency at check-in.
- Proof must be valid at sailing.
- The offer is limited to 50 staterooms per sailing.
- The discount applies to voyage fare only.
- Taxes, Fees and Port Expenses are excluded.
- The offer cannot be combined with another special offer or discount.
- The offer is valid on new and existing reservations, subject to Disney terms.
- Rate and cabin availability must be checked at booking.
